summary.source: Three read-only sweeps of the public site, game shell and server/ops, then live-code implementation.
summary.verificationNote: Source b62e4bb1ca408ee1953729a06157ca43c22771c5 (feature f9296f6 + fix b62e4bb on Studio OS sync a888ef0). Direct six-shard suite 1748/1748 at 10b145c (core 290, runtime 996, sim-contract 85, sim-realism 9, long 3, studio 365), exit 0; studio 365/365 re-run after each rebase onto the two docs-only Studio OS syncs. Full Playwright suite: 25 initial failures traced to pinned wording, collapsed Advanced settings and a hidden dev row whose .row display overrode [hidden]; all fixed and the affected specs re-run green (46 then 22 then 12 passing). Pre-receipt /code-review found four defects (restored-session potential leak, playoff stats in regular-season records, two lost spaces), all fixed with a non-vacuous regression and negative control. Stable staging 14/14 verified for artifact a3965277…. Public launch remains HOLD.

premises.claim: Desk command head speaks to players

L1.recipe: Correct the primary seam and pin it with a negative control.

L2.recipe: Rewrite every visible engineering string in the game shell and public pages, keep the honesty voice, and extend the public-copy gate with the internal vocabulary plus a negative control.

L3.recipe: Rewrite every visible engineering string in the game shell and public pages, keep the honesty voice, and extend the public-copy gate with the internal vocabulary plus a negative control. Verify in rendered browser states across both themes and phone width.
